name: virtual-finder
description: Local-first macOS desktop app for AI-organized virtual file browsing
author: Fily Team

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/dev.cjs
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/ui && cd apps/desktop && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && cd apps/desktop && npm run package
scripts.postinstall: npm run rebuild && npm run doctor
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/dist apps/*/dist apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:desktop && npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/desktop
scripts.ci:check: npm run build && npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w apps/desktop
